tei:div.tei:p: (tsa)༄༅// dpal ldan sa skya pa rje btsun gong ma lnga'i rtogs brjod dang*/ gzhan yang bstod tshogs 'ga' zhig bzhugs// rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma lnga'i rtogs brjod las/ sa skya pa chen po'i rtogs brjod// ༄// swasti/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /skabs su rgyal sras sbyin pa'i dpal// phyogs 'dir 'khon gyi tshul 'dzin pa'i// dpal ldan brtse ba chen po ni// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa// bsam yas 'gro ba'i don slad du// bsams shing skye ba bzhes gyur pa// yin par ma 'khrul shes byed ni// brgya phrag stong gi 'thad pa dang*// bcas pas legs par grub zin pa// de la rnam dpyod rtsal ldan dag /som nyir 'gyur ba'i go skabs ci// nyid kyi gdung 'tshob sras dang ni// brgyud par bcas pa rim byon pa// de dag rnams kyis chos dang ni// srid kyi phyag rjes gang bzhag pa// sngon dus byung bar gyur zin dang*// da ltar yod dang ma 'ongs su// gdon mi za bar 'byung nges pa'i// rgyu tshogs ma tshang med 'di dag /spyan ras gzigs dbang lta bu yi// snying rje can dang mthu stobs kyi// dbang phyug bir+wa pa lta bu/ min pa su zhig gis bskrun nus// de phyir khyod la phyag btsal bas// khyod kyi rdo rje rnam gsum po// gang 'di'i rdo rje rnam gsum la// nam yang 'bral ba med gyur cig /shubhaṃ// // ༄༅// swasti/ slob dpon rin po che la bstod pa/ dpal ldan 'dus pa'i gzhal med khang dbus su// brtse chen 'jam pa'i rdo rje yum bcas pas// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo mngal nas 'byin tshul gyi// rigs sras bskrun pa'i cho gas 'dir 'khrungs pa// 'jam pa'i dpal nyid gdung 'tshob rigs bzhir byon// rdo rje rnon po kun dga' ye shes 'bar// rin chen rigs gyur bsod nams ye shes rtse// dbang phyug brgyad mnga' 'jam dpal grags pa'i mtshan// phrin las ma lus grub pa'i dpal chen 'od// dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i thugs kyi bang mdzod la// dbang 'byor grub pa chen po'i sa brnyes pa// mi thub zla bar grags pa'i dpa' bo ni// bod yul bsod nams rtse mor 'khrungs so zhes// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rdo rje'i gdan sgo la// yi ger bris pa'i ri mo gsal mthong ba'i// ye shes spyan ldan mang pos 'dir bsngags pa// sngon bsags bsod nams rtse mor byon 'di ni// brtse chen nyid las brgyud pa'i gsang sngags chos// dbang gzhung man ngag zab mor gyur ji snyed// gcig nas gcig tu bum pa gang byo'i tshul// gsan cing nyams myong grub pa'i sa dang ni// kun kyang 'chad la rigs dang grol bas ni// smra ba'i spobs pa chu bo'i rgyun lta bu// bco brgyad rang lo'i dus su lhun gyis grub// de nas de tshe pha rol phyin pa yi// chos lugs kun dang rigs gzhung zla bral ba// mdo dang sde bdun bsdus par bcas de dag

/ne'u'i thog na chos kyi seng ge zhes// mdo yul mkhas pa'i gtsug na lham me ba// de gsung nyid las lo grangs bcu gcig tu// rigs par sbyangs nas 'chad dang rtsom pa la// sa stengs kun na mkhas pa'i grags dkar thob// de nas gdan sar lo grangs bcu lhag tu// rang gzhan gzhung lugs 'chad dang rtsod pa dang*// bstan pa'i srog shing tshugs par brtsoms pa dang*// bskyed rim bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa dang*// rdzogs rim ye shes rtse mor byon mdzad nas// mtha' yas 'gro ba dbang gis smin pa dang*// skal bzang mang po lam gyis grol ba dang*// gong ma'i chos lugs yid bzhin nor bu'i dpal// grags pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor bkod zin nas// gangs can ljongs 'dir gzhan gyis mi bskrun pa'i// rigs gnas mdo rgyud man ngag chu bo'i rgyun// srid mtha'i bar du 'bab la gegs med pa'i// bka' drin bla med stsol mdzad bsod nams brtse// phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub de brnyes nas// mnyam rjes kun tu ma dag snang ba ni// ci yang mi gzigs sku lus de nyid kyis// bde ba can du gshegs zhes ye shes kyi// spyan ldan mang pos gsal bar mthong ba can// la las gzhan du mthong yang ma dag pa'i// rdzun snang 'khrul par su zhig yid rton byed// 'jig rten yul las 'das khyod phyag gi gnas// mdo sngags gzhung gi mngon rtogs dpag bsam shing*// rab brtan rtsa ba tshugs par 'dzugs pa dang*// rtog pa'i rlung gis nam yang mi bsgul dang*// 'chi med nyams len bdud rtsis 'dir khengs pa// gong ma'i snyan brgyud khyod kyis yi ger bkod// ngo bo nyid med smra gzhung spros pa yi// mtshan 'dzin khegs pa'i rigs gzhung bzang mod kyi// rnam grangs min pa'i don dam ma bstan zhes// thal rang dbu ma'i nges pa khyod kyis bshad// zung 'jug blo yi nyams su blang bya'i chos// rnam grangs min pa'i don dam bden gang de// rnyed thabs sngags las lugs gzhan la med ces// grub mtha'i rtse mo sngags kyi dbu ma ni// mtha' bral tshul du thogs mar bsam byas nas// zung 'jug tshul gyis nyams su len shes pa// mdo rgyud mngon rtogs dpag bsam khyod kyi drin// pha rol phyin gzhung rgyas par ma bslabs na// mtha' bral dbu ma de ltar ston nus su// gong ma'i rgyud pa las 'ongs rim med na// zung 'jug tshul de nyams su len mkhas su// de ltar bsod nams brtse mo thams cad mkhyen// mchog gi dngos grub brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// shu bhaṃ/// /

༄༅// swasti/ grags pa'i zhabs kyi rtogs brjod/ de nyid kyi zhabs la nye bar btud de skyabs su mchi'o// lha dang lha min bdud dang mu stegs byed// mang po dag kyang khyod kyi zhabs rdul len// rgya gar paṇa chen la la'i dregs 'joms pa'i// rig pa'i gnas dang gzhung lugs kun mkhyen pa'i// rnam dkar grags pa'i gdugs dkar 'dzin khyod kyis// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par bzung byas nas// dbon brgyud rim par byon rnams 'dzam gling gi /sa skyong rgyal po'i phyag bya'i gnas su mdzad// gla rtsi'i dri tsam gyis kyang gdug pa'i sbrul// rgyang rig yul nas phyir bzlog brtsom pa ltar// khyod kyi mtshan tsam gyis kyang dpal mo'i dpal// dpung gi tshogs pas sa gsum yul 'di bor// gnam the dkar pos khyod zhabs 'dud byas nas// kho bo'i brgyud pas 'dzam gling skyong ba'i tshe// khyod kyi dbon brgyud mchod pa'i gnas so zhes// yang yang gsol gdab dang du blangs byas nas// ma 'ongs lung bstan byed po khyod kyi ni// bod yul 'gyur ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos kun// gzigs par ma mdzad gang yang yod min zhing*// 'chad par mi nus lta zhig ga la mnga'// de phyir 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus su ni// ma bshad gzhung 'ga' med cing dgongs 'grel tshe// dka' ba'i gnas 'ga' gud du lus ma mchis// de phyir phyogs rnams kun las rnam par rgyal// dus der mang du gsan pa'i mchog gyur dang*// rdo rje 'dzin kun 'dus pa'i gtso bo zhes// kun khyab grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin khyod la// sus kyang mi 'gran phrag dog yul ma gyur// rang rigs gong ma'i chos lugs yongs rdzogs pa// brtse chen nyid dang de sras mthu bo las// thos bsam sgom pa'i tshul de smin gyur pas// bshes gnyen gzhan gyi zhal ngo brten ma dgos// chos dang srid kyi 'byor tshogs gang ji snyed// 'bad med dgos pa chu chen rnam bzhi po// rgya mtshor ji bzhin lhun gyis grub gyur pas// yul gzhan bgrod pa'i rnam g.yeng 'dis ma mdzad// sangs rgyas yul nas gang du 'khrungs gyur pa'i// gnas 'di nyid du slar gshegs tshul yang bstan// de de'i bar du mnyam gzhag rnal 'byor dang*// rjes spyod gtso bo rang gzhung brtsom pa dang*// gzhan la 'chad dang mtshan bcas rnal 'byor kun// thun gcig tsam yang rnam par g.yeng mi mnga'// bsnyen sgrub yan lag ma tshang med de kun// phal cher gnas de nyid du mthar phyin mdzad// khyad par rnal 'byor dbang phyug gsung gi mdzod// snyan nas snyan brgyud ma 'ongs dus dag tu// bskyud pa spang phyir 'khrul med yi ge'i lam// gsal bar dod pa'i bka' drin khyod kyis mdzad// gdan sar mi skye'i chos la bzod pa brnyes// gser mdog can du mi dbang 'khor lo bsgyur// rig 'dzin gnas su sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*// grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin khyod bstod byas pas// gangs can ljongs su la la'i byin brlabs kyis// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bdag po'i me tog mda'// dgra med ngang gis 'jug pa ngos bzung nas// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal thob shog

/zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// shu bhaṃ/// / ༄༅// swasti/ gangs can ljongs su sa skya'i paṇa chen la// mi bstod mi bkur su yang yod min mod// gang gis mdzad pa'i las stabs gang dang gang*// de de glo bar byas nas mgu byed su// gzhan gyis ma mdzad gang gis mdzad 'di ltar// shes 'dod yod dam shes nas dad par byos// 'phags pa'i yul du rnam 'grel mdzad po las// rigs pa'i srol chen rgyas pa sngon ma byung*// gangs can ljongs su de gzhung ji bzhin pa// 'dzin mdzad 'di las gong du gzhan ma byung*// rnam 'grel rgyan bcas sngon nas 'gyur zin kyang*// mdo sems grub mtha' 'gog pa'i tshad bsdus kyi// sprin rum 'thug po'i gseb nas rnam 'grel gyi// nyin byed rgyal po gsal bar 'char ma nus// gang 'di'i phrin las rta bdun kha lo pas// nyin byed rgyal po chos dbyings nam mkha' la// 'dren byed thag thogs med pa'i rol rtsed kyis// gangs can gling bzhi ya mtshan ltad mor byas// 'gyur mdzad mang pos chos mang po bsgyur yang*// tshig don mtha' dag 'phags yul mkhas la sbyangs// gang 'dis brda sprod tshig don rang yul du// gzhan la ma ltos mkhyen nas 'gyur mang mdzad// gangs can ljongs su 'di'i sngon ma 'gyur ba'i// sgra dang tshig rgyan sdeb sbyor ming gi mdzod// rgya dpe nyid la bslabs shing sbyangs pas mkhyen// lo tsā'i mtshan dang paṇa chen grags dkar thob// rigs brgyud gong ma'i thugs la bzhed gyur kyang*// phyag len nyid du ji bzhin ma khel ba// mtshan nyid theg pa'i bshad srol gsar btsugs nas// sgra tshad mdo sngags sgrub pa'i srol chen pos// rang rang mdun sar nyi ma ji bzhin du// dregs pas rgyal ba'i rgyu skar zil gyis mnan// bstan pa'i rtsa ba so thar sdom pa'i tshogs// ma tshang med de rang gis blangs mdzad nas// ngur smig 'dzin pa'i mchog tshogs sde chen po// rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas nyid du lhag par spel// 'dzam gling chos bzhin skyong ba'i rgyal po yis// khyod zhabs spyi bor blangs pa'i snga rol du// bod yul grub rig grags ldan su zhig kyang*// phyag mchod yul du byed pa de ma byung*// sngon dus chos dang chos min spel mar ni// bod 'dir byung tshe bstan pa phyogs re ba// spel dang chos min nyi tshe ba tsam re// sun 'byin nus pa'i mthu ldan 'ga' byon mod// chos min smra rnams ma lus drungs 'byin pa'i// lung rigs mthu rtsal grub pa'i dpa' bo khyod// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i ma dros mtsho chen po// sa 'dir 'bebs mdzad tshangs chen ma lags sam// phyi dus 'di na 'chad brtsod rtsom pa dang*// rig pa'i gnas la dregs pas myos de dag

/mtshan dpe'i dpal dang mya ngan 'das rtags kyis// khyod la 'gran pa'i khengs pa btang min nam// mtho ris dpal dang mkhas btsun yon tan dang*// 'gro ba'i don dang bstan la phan dgongs dang*// bzhugs pa'i dus dang phyi ma'i dus 'dir yang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang mtshungs khyod la phyag 'tshal// zhes bya ba ni grub pa'o// shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// swasti/ 'phags pa'i rtogs brjod mdo tsam du bya ba// de nyid kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sprul pa'i lo tsā dpal brtsegs bsrung ba dang*// sems dpa' chen po sa ston rir grags pa// mtha' yas 'gro don dgongs pa'i lhag bsam gyis// kun gyis mchod 'os gyur pa'i rigs nyid du// 'khrungs ma thag nas 'od gsal byang chub pas// 'phags pa'i thugs mnga' zhi lhag zung 'jug la// ngang gis gzhol bas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// dus der mngon du mdzad la thogs med kyang*// rgyal ba'i sras rnams srid par skye ba'i rgyu// nyon mongs mi spong rang bzhin can gang gis// bgrang yas 'gro ba'i don du thugs bskyed pa// de don pha rol phyin rnams tshe gcig la// rdzogs byed thabs zab 'khor lo sgyur ba yi// rgyal ba'i don mdzad kho nar mkhyen gyur pas// sngon med lhun po'i dpal khyod bsngags par 'os// mthong ba'i mod la dang ba 'dren pa'i sku// phyag dang mchod tshe byin gyis brlabs pa'i gsung*// re zhig brten na phan par dgongs pa'i thugs// yun du brten na phun tshogs kun stsol bas// khros pa'i bzhin ras nam yang mi ston zhing*// rtsub mo'i tshig mda' gang du'ang gsung mi mdzad// phan par dgongs las gzhan pa'i thugs mi mnga'// gdul byar gyur la phun tshogs sna re tsam// gang du yang ni ma stsal yod min pas// 'phags pa'i mtshan gang don la gnas gyur pa// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad khyod la 'gran nus pa// 'ga' zhig yod na la las ston pa rigs// kha cig chos kyi 'byor pas phyug gyur kyang*// srid pa'i 'byor pas rang srog 'tsho ba tsam// sa skyong rgyal po srid las dbang 'byor yang*// chos kyi dbang phyug nyin mo'i skar ma tsam// srid pa'i 'byor pa 'khor lo sgyur rgyal dang*// chos kyi longs spyod mang pos mi 'gran pa// ser skya'i grong du don grub byon de bzhin// dam pa'i gnas su 'phags khyod gsal bar byon// rigs brgyud gong ma'i chos tshul bgrang yas pa// rje nyid las gsan brgyud pa'i srol chen gzung*// sa chen bstan pa yid bzhin nor bu'i dpal// 'byor ba'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor khyod kyis bteg

/gang la spyir dge bsod nams char chen gyis// thub bstan yid bzhin nor mtsho khengs par shog /zhes bya ba ni grub pa'o// shu bhaṃ// ༈ //chos kyi rje nyid la bstan 'dzin gzhan las khyad par 'phags par bstod pa tshangs pa'i rnga sgra// ༄// swasti/ kun dga'i zhabs sen 'char kha'i mdangs gsal ni// shar phyogs sa skyong ri bo'i cod paṇa gyi// rgyal mtshan rtse mor mchod 'os 'gro ba'i dpal// bzang po'i nyi ma 'jam gling yongs la gsal// kun khyab grags pa'i 'chi med rnga chen yang*// 'phags yul sum rtsen dga' ba'i tshal du bsgrags// rgyal rnga brdungs pa'i paṇa chen mang pos kyang*// khyod zhabs ya mtshan gus pa'i gtsug gis len// kun mkhyen ming 'dzin dpal gyi mgrin pa can// smra mkhas 'phrog byed dga' ba'i ral ba yi// rgyal mtshan rtse la zhabs rdul zla ba'i gar// rtsed 'phyo lhur byed khyod las gzhan pa su// kun mkhyen ral pa'i khur 'dzin dga' byed kyi// dregs pa'i rgyal mtshan mthon po rab bsnyal nas// 'gro kun dga' ba'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni// srid pa'i rtse dang mnyam pa khyod kyis sgrengs// rnam dpyod kun gsal dga' ma'i mdzes sdug gis// rgyal ba'i chos kyi dge mtshan mdza' bo ni// 'di na dbang du ma bsdus gcig kyang med// dpal ldan rig gnas stong gi lang tsho can// bzang po'i mtshar sdug kun gyi yid 'ong khyod// sa stengs 'gro ba'i bsod nams zong gis thob// chos kun sgyu mar gzigs pa'i mche sder gyis// dngos smra'i glang chen dga' ma bsad pa las// lta ba'i khrag gis sbags pa'i ral pa yi// rgyal mtshan g.yo mdzad smra ba'i seng ge khyod// dpal ldan 'jigs med bzang po'i nga ro can// thub bstan gangs ri'i ngogs la rnam par rgyu// bstan 'dzin mdza' bos spangs pa'i sngo sangs ma// mun pa'i mal du lan gcig nyal ba na// nag phyogs las rgyal mtshan dpe'i ri mo can// dpal ldan phrin las bzang po'i zla ba shar// kun dga'i nyi ma rnam dpyod 'od stong can// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ya mtshan gyis// mi nub bstan pa'i mkha' la rol rtsed mkhan// dpal ldan phrin las bzang po'i nyi ma khyod// grags pa'i dbang phyug kun gyi rna ba snyan// mkhyen pa'i mnga' bdag thams cad dga' ba'i gsung*// thugs rje che ldan bdud las rgyal ba'i thugs// mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar bzang po'i sku mnga' khyod// kun dga' snying po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis// dpal gyi gdung 'tshob bzang po'i srol bzung nas// sa skya pa zhes grags pa'i sgra dbyangs ni// khyod kyis gsal bar bsgrags la phyag 'tshal lo// gangs can 'di na sgrub de dag

/'ga' zhig gsan pa'i nor gyis dbul// la la thos pa dri med pa// ldan kyang sgrub pa'i bdud rtsis 'phongs// mang thos rnam dpyod bde byung gi /kun dga'i rgyal mtshan rtse mo der// sgrub la brtson pa'i zla ba ni// ci yang 'char ba khyod gcig nyid// la la pha rol phyin gzhung gi /thos pa'i rgya mtsho rab brgal kyang*// sngags gzhung yid bzhin nor bu yi// 'dod pa'i de nyid don ma gzigs// mdo rgyud kun gyi rgya mtsho las// zag med dga' bzhi'i bde thob pas// sa bcu'i rgyal mtshan rtser son pa// dbang gi rgyal po khyod gcig nyid// 'di na chen por rab grags 'ga'// sde snod de nyid legs gzigs kyang*// sgra dang tshad ma'i gzhung lugs kyi// tha snyad gzigs pa'i lam ma gyur// la la tshad ma'i gzhung lugs la// rab tu sbyangs par ldan de dag /brda sprod gzhung gi cha shas kyang*// gsan pa'i yul du ma gyur to// mkhyen rab khor yug yangs pa'i dbus// gzhan 'joms rtog ge'i lta zer can// brda sprod byed pa'i phuṭa sgra dang*// skad gnyis smra ba'i lce ldan pa'i// rnam dpyod yangs pa'i zhal gyi sgor// thub bstan chu bo kun bsdud cing*// legs bshad rin chen mdzod bzung nas// phrin las chu bo stong 'bebs pa// mkhas pa'i rgya mtshos bsten 'os khyod// gangs can yid bzhin nor mtsho'i dpal// rnam dpyod skya ba 'dzin mkhas pas// sde snod gsung dang sgra tshad dang*// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mthar son nas// grub pa'i yid bzhin nor blangs pa// rgyal sras blo ldan shes rab kyang*// bzo dang gso ba rig pa yi// gnas la gdengs thob med pas na// paṇa chen ded dpon mtshan ma thogs// rig pa'i gnas lnga legs gzigs te// kun gyi phyag rjes rab bzhag nas// 'chad rtsod rtsom pas dus 'da' ba// 'gran zla bral ba khyod gcig nyid// lnga rig grub pa'i sar zhugs nas// gsung rab mang po'i 'gyur mdzad de// gangs can blo yi mun sel ba// dpal ldan rin chen bzang pos kyang*// tshig rgyan gzhung dang mngon brjod dang*// sdeb sbyor gzhung gi ming tsam yang*// bsgyur bar mdzad pa'i rtsol ma thob// mthon po'i go 'phangs 'dzin mi mdzad// sngon rabs gangs can mkhas pa yi// blo gros mgrin par ma bzung ba'i// tha snyad gzhung brgya'i mu tig gi

/bkod legs phreng ba khyod kyis spel// rnam dpyod lang tsho g.yo ldan pa// kun gyi skye mched gsal bar mdzad// mtho ris yon tan rab rdzogs pa// khyod dang mnyam pa gzhan ma byung*// sngon chad phyogs 'dir ma 'gyur ba'i// 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gzhung ji bzhin// khyod kyis mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo// tshig gi gter dang me tog gi /chun po brtsam par mdzad de 'dra// gangs can 'di na sngon ma byung*// phan dgongs thugs rje che ldan pa'i// skad gnyis mkhyen pa mang zhig gis// gzhung lugs mang po bsgyur mdzad mod// zhu chen bgyis nas 'gyur mdzad cing*// dgongs 'grel bstan bcos mang mdzad pa// khyod dang mnyam pa 'ga' ma byung*// brtson 'grus ldan pa de dag kun// phal cher rnam dpyod dga' bas dben// khyod kyi rnam dpyod nyi ma ni// brtson pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse nas 'char// dam pa'i gzhung gi rjes zhugs te// 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos kyis// kun kyang phan dang bde ba'i sgor// 'jug mdzad khyod min gzhan su zhig /chos dang srid kyi gzhung lugs kyi// rwa ba mthon po la 'chongs pa'i// rang bzo'i glang chen smyon pa ni// 'dzem me 'phyo ba'i 'brog dgon par// dam chos yid bzhin rin chen ni// kun gyi rin thang nyams pa na// lung dang rigs pa'i byi dor gyis// thub bstan dri ma sbyangs mdzad nas// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nor bu ni// kun dga'i rgyal mtshan rtse la bkod// zhabs sen 'jigs med dpa' bo ni// sa skyong ral pa'i nags su 'khrungs// chos dang srid kyi gzhung lugs kyis// 'gro mang dbugs dbyung mdzad khyod lags// 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can gyi// ljongs 'dir thub pa'i gzhung bzhin du// rang bzo'i lam du ma zhugs par// rang gzhung rtsom pa mang mod kyang*// sngags dang pha rol phyin gzhung la// rang gzhan sde pas rnam btags pa// log pa'i gzhung lugs sun 'byin pa'i// gzhung rtsom mdzad pa khyod min su// phyogs 'dir mdo dang rgyud sde yi// don tsam gzigs pa'i mngon rlom gyis// sgra yi tshig zur ma byin par// don nyid 'chad mdzad mang mod kyi// yi ge bsnan pa'i nges tshig dang*// rang rang rnam dbye ma 'dres par// brda sprod byed pa'i gzhung bzhin du// 'chad mdzad khyod mtshungs 'dir ma byung*// tshig dor ltag chod lhur blangs nas// rtsod par mdzad pa 'di na mang*// rtog ge'i gzhung bzhin bsgrub pa dang*// sun 'byin tshul lugs thugs chud nas// dam pa'i gzhung bzhin rtsad mdzad pas// phyi nang mu stegs pham mdzad khyod// mnyam par bzhag las mi g.yo bzhin// rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig la// lhag par dgongs nas 'chad pa dang*// rtsod rtsom mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar sgrub pa'i dge ba ni// lam gsum bgrod pa'i rgyun mang gis// srid gsum 'phrog byed rkang pa'i dug

/ma lus legs par bsal byas nas// legs bshad skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun// log blo'i dri mas ma bslad par// shing rta'i srol gyi rjes zhugs nas// thub bstan rgya mtshor 'jug byed shog /ces chos rje nyid la gar gyi nyams dang*/ bstan 'dzin gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sgo nas bstod pa tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ yul dbus kyi snyan ngag mkhan/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ mgrin snyan dbyangs kyi lo'am lcags mo yos kyi lo gro bzhin can gyi yar tshes kyi dga' ba dang po la gtsang g.yas ru'i bkra shis rgyal gyi lha khang du rnyog pa med pa'i yid kyis sbyar zhing kha ton du byas pa'o// // ༄༅// dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas dang gang zag la sgra las drangs pa'i bstod pa/ ngag gi dbang po'i dga' ston zhes bya ba/ gdong pa bzhi ldan rwa gzhu dang ldan 'bar ba'i skra can mda' lnga pa// pags pa'i gos can mche ba gcig pa lag na mdung thogs rta gdong can// stobs kyi dgra dang za byed zhags pa can de srid sde'i byed po yis// kun nas myos par byas pa'i 'gro 'di 'dul mkhas kun mkhyen gtsug na rgyal// sa skya zhes pa'i ming*/ yi ge'i dang po/ sa'i skad dod/ go'u zhes pa'i yi ge'i 'du 'god kyi dbang gis/ ngag phyogs/ sa/ 'od zer/ ba glang*/ mig rdo rje/ mtho ris/ chu ste/ don dgu la 'jug pa la/ rkang pa re re sbyar zhing*/ bla ma rnams kyi mtshan gyi spel ma yang*/ bod kyi sgra rgyan dang mthun pa spangs te/ sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung bzhin brjod par bya'o// ngag gi dbang po'i dge mtshan brgya phrag shig /phyogs brgyar 'phros pa'i dpal yon 'dus pa las// sa skyong dbang po stong gis gus btud pa'i// 'od zer brgya phreng 'khrigs pa'i gur khang du// glang chen dkar pos bteg pa'i khri stengs der// mig gnyis 'dzum pa'i gar sgyur 'jam pa'i dpal// rdo rje rnon po bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs can// mtho ris dbang po'i lus la mdzes zhugs nas/

chu bo'i gter bzhin thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dpal// legs par gnas pa sa 'dzin dkar po'i khyon// sa skya zhes grags snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs ni// stong gsum khor yug ri bo'i khongs las brgal// 'dab brgya'i lte ba la gnas 'od steng gis 'bar li khri'i lus can dhīḥyig ni// snying rje'i zla zer dang 'grogs 'gro la chags pa'i tsha zer dbang po zhu ba las// legs par 'khrungs pa'i yid 'phrog gzhon nu chags pa'i nyams ldan 'gying zhing sgeg pa can// mi zad tshig gi gter mchog dri zhim zur phud lnga ldan de la 'dud// srid pa'i rgya mtsho ring nas legs brgal kyang*// zhi ba'i gnas su yud tsam mi bzhugs la// phyi nang chos kyi de nyid ston mkhas pa'i// kun dga' snying po skye dgu'i gtsug na mdzes// sbyang dka' zla ba'i bsod nams ye shes tshogs// grangs med bskal par bskrun pa'i mthu grub pa// sa bcu'i rtse mor son pa'i rig sngags 'chang*// gnas lnga rig pa bsod nams brtse mo'i zhabs// rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter gyi bka' grub pa// rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi bang mdzod la// dbang sgyur rgyal po grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal// srid pa gsum na khyod dang mtshungs ma mchis// blo gsal kun dga'i 'dzum chen dgod pa'i rtser// gzhung lugs mi 'dra'i rgyal mtshan stong sgreng cing*// 'jam pa'i dpal zhes grags pa'i gdugs bzang po// legs par 'dzin pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta// blo gros yid bzhin mtsho la dbang 'byor zhing*// phrin las ma la ya rlung phyogs mthar g.yo// rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal srid chen po la// dbang 'byor chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i mtshan// dri med yon tan kun ldan sa skya pa// gangs can ljongs 'dir khyod dang mtshungs pa yi// skyabs gzhan phyogs brgyar btsal yang ma mthong bas// khyod nyid 'ba' zhig gus pa'i gtsug gis mchod// de skad smra ba nga yin sde snod gsum shes gsang sngags 'dzin pa nga*// brda sprod byed gzhung ngas bslabs da lta nga las snyan ngag mkhas pa gang*// rtog ge'i gzhung la sbyangs pa nga che tha snyad phal cher nga la dris// deng sang 'di na nga brgyad smra bar rigs pa nga las gzhan yod min// nga brgyad smras pa tsam gyis sa skya pa// kun dga' rgyal mtshan nyid dang mtshungs so zhes// snang shas dbang gis cha ched byung rgyal du// mngon pa'i nga rgyal sgrogs pa ga la yin// mtshungs bral rnam dpyod chen po'i dge legs kyis// rab 'byams shes bya'i gnas rnams phal cher la// rmongs pa'i phyogs tsam gsal ba'i mngon rlom gyis// dpal ldan sa skyar de skad smra ba po// shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo// zhes bya ba 'di ni/

na tshod ldan gyi lo/ khrums kyi zla ba'i phyogs dang po'i stong pa dang po la shākya'i dge slong mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros kyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rgya ma ba sangs rgyas dbon gyi bstod pa bzhugs// ༄// swasti prā dzā bh+ye/ 'jig rten dbang po'i thugs rje'i lang tsho ni// 'dzum dkar mdangs kyis 'khyud pa'i gzhon nu ma// bde 'byung thod na gnas pa'i 'od phreng can// legs par shar ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// nam yang gzhon nu'i sa las g.yo med par// phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa spel bya'i phyir// gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon du 'khrungs gyur pa// yongs kyi bshes gnyen dam pa bsngags par 'os// bskal bzang 'di la slad nas 'byon 'gyur ba'i// skal ldan shing rta zhes bya'i sangs rgyas su// rje btsun sgrol mas kha che'i paṇa chen la// lung bstan gyur pa sangs rgyas dbon gyi mtshan// siṅga lar 'khrungs sprul pa'i dgra bcom gyis// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i pho nya zhes// ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa'i phyag nyid du// pad dkar phreng mdzes springs pa sangs rgyas dbon// byams pa'i phyag gis bde ba'i gnas su 'dren// thugs rje'i rgyun chen phongs ba'i gnas su 'bebs// gnas skabs bde zhing yun du phan dgongs pa// nyams thag 'gro ba mang po'i mgon du gyur// de ltar bsngags pa'i dge legs gangs ri'i tog /rab dkar ku mud brtsegs pa'i do shal can// ngag gi dbang po'i chu gter nas 'ongs pa// mtshan rtog ri gzhan mthon pos ma mnan par// dmigs med lhun po'i spo nas bshad bsgrub kyi// rgyal thabs lan brgyar bshams pa'i dge ba las// mi mthun rkyen dang mthar byed pho nya'i bzhin// chos dbyings nags kyi mdzes mas len gyur cig/ //shu bhaṃ// ༄༅// na mo bo dhi satwa ye/ sems dpa' chen po glang ri thang pa'i zhabs la bstod pa/

byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ sngon tshe byang chub dam par thugs bskyed nas// rlabs chen spyod pas 'gro rnams grol bya'i phyir// rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnam 'phrul bgrang yas kyis// bsam yas 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// nges pa'i don du 'od dpag med pa'i sku// nyams thag 'gro la spyan ras gzigs kyi gsung*// rtag tu gzhan phan dgongs pa khyod kyi thugs// gangs can ljongs 'dir 'khrungs la phyag 'tshal lo// byams pa'i shugs kyis mtha' yas 'gro ba kun// 'phral dang yun gyi bde ba la drangs nas// snying rje'i shing rtas 'gro ba'i sdig sdug kun// khyod kyis nges par blangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rang gzhan gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa rab zhi nas// gnyis med ngang nas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// mchog tu rang las gces par dgongs gyur pa// yongs kyi bshes gnyen dam par phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu bzod dka'i gnod byed ma rungs pa// rgyal ba ji bzhin mchod par 'os pa dang*// yid bzhin nor bzhin dgos 'dod 'byung gnas su// nges par mkhyen pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// theg chen chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems// bdag gzhan brje ba'i lam srol zla bral ba// gangs can ljongs 'dir dang por khyod kyis bstan// bka' drin mnyam med de la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed pa dang*// gzhan gyis bgyis la rjes su yid rang ba'i// dge de ma rnams don du bsngos pa yis// rnam dkar mchod pa bzang pos mnyes par bgyi// de ltar phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis// srid zhir 'dun pa'i spros pa kun sbyangs shing*// chos brgyad mtshan ma'i g.yeng ba dang bral nas// chos dbyings ngang nas gzhan phan lhun grub shog /de'i 'og tu/ bdag ni sems can thams cad la// zhes sogs sh+lau ka brgyad 'don par bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni bshes gnyen dam pa smon lam bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor bgyis nas/

mi pham dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis dpal glang ri thang gi gtsug lag khang du nye bar sbyar ba yin no// ༈ //rgya ma'i sgyer khu dbon gyi bstod pa bzhugs// ༄// swasti/ sgyer mchog dkar po lhas gnang rigs// bsam bzhin dbu ru byang phyogs su// sku 'khrungs gzhon nu 'od las ni// rab byung thos bsam mthar phyin nas// dngos grub mnyes tshe sgyer sgom zhes// sa stengs ma lus rnam dkar gyi// grags pas khyab nas bstan pa yi// phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti sha'i thugs kyi bcud// zab mo sngags kyi lam rim pa// sne'u zur ba nas brgyud de la// mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// glang ri thang pa phya de 'ur// byon tshe bdag gzhan brje ba yi// byang chub sems mnos thugs rgyud la// mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sgyer sgom che dbon gzhon nu yi// mtshan can mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub 'byung gnas su grags pa// khyod la gus pas gsol ba 'debs// mdo rgyud bstan bcos ma lus dang*// rig pa'i gnas rnams mthar son pa// de tshe khyod la ston par grags// dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs// mchog gi dngos grub 'dir brnyes pa// de tshe bgegs rigs 'byung po'i tshogs// mthar mdzad snyan pa'i grags pa yis// khyab mdzad khyod la gsol ba 'debs// thun mong dngos grub 'dir brnyes pa// de tshe rdo rje chos skyong rnams// bran bzhin 'khol mdzad 'byor pa'i tshogs// ma lus bsgrub la gsol ba 'debs// ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa yis// skal ldan shing rta zhes bya ba'i// byang chub sems dpa' dngos yin zhes// lung bstan khyod la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// phul byung ston pa'i bka' srol mchog /snyigs dus dri mas ma sbags par// dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis spyon// de nas 'di bskul mdzad po yang*// pha rol 'tshe ba med pa dang*// mnga' 'bangs mtsho bzhin gang ba dang*// dbu rmog gong nas gong btsan shog

/zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// shu bhaṃ// ༈ //bu ston lo tsā ba la bstod pa bsngags 'os bsngags pa'i phreng ba bzhugs// ༄// na mo mañju shrī ye/ rgyan drug mkhas pa'i gdung 'tshob rigs kyi bu// ston pa'i rgyal tshab bstan 'dzin yongs kyi yab// rin chen dkon mchog gsum dngos rdo rje 'dzin// dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas 'khor lo'i mgon// sa stengs 'gran zla bral ba'i bsod snyoms pa// ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa shākya shrī/

de yi skye bar grags/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis ljongs 'dir 'khrungs gyur pa// mkhyen rab dbang po bu ston rin chen grub// thub pas 'jam dpal rtsab las/ yi ge ra dang sa dang po// dge slong gang zhig rab byung gsungs// ston pa'i bstan pa gsal byed pa// 'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med// ces/ lung bstan brtse chen rgyal ba'i sras// smon lam mthu grub rig pa'i gnas rnams sbyangs// lhag bsam rnam dag phrin las dbang phyug mchog /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyi ma gang 'dir shar// khro phu ba yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge las nges par rab tu byung*// tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon las phar tshad mngon gsum sbyangs// paṇa chen rgyud chos lung tshogs pa/ las bsnyen par rdzogs mdzad nas// mkhan chen ka bzhi pa/ grags gzhon drung du 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs sbyangs// skad gnyis smra ba thar pa lo tsā nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ las// brda sprod byed pa'i gzhung lugs mthar phyin mdzad// kun mkhyen 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho rong*/ rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan/ mtshan sogs la// sngags gzhung rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i pha rol son// sngon chad gangs can ljongs 'dir 'gyur zin pa'i// gzhung lugs kun gyi zhus chen bshad srol mdzad// 'gyur zin chos kyi kha skong dag byed du// sngon med 'gyur mdzad zhus chen lo tsā ba// bstan pa'i rtsa ba legs gsungs 'dul ba yi// lung gi zhus chen gzhung brgya'i bshad srol dang*// lag len mchog gis bstan pa'i skye mched ni// gsal mdzad khyod dang mnyam pa sngon ma byung*// lhun stug byin chags rnal 'byor rgyud chen po'i// 'grel mdzad rgya gar paṇa chen mang byon yang*// bshad pa'i lus rdzogs yan lag kun tshang ba'i// gzhung rtsom byed po khyod mtshungs gzhan ma byon// dpyod ldan mgu byed bstan pa'i rgyan gcig po// dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam dang rig pa'i gnas// kun gyi gsal byed rnam bshad rgya che ba// mdzad po khyod sngon 'grel byed gzhan ma byon// de ltar bod kyi yul 'dir sngon byon pa'i// paṇa grub mang po'i rnam thar dpag dka' yang*// rtsom pa'i phreng bas bstan pa gsal mdzad pa// bu ston lo tsā dang mtshungs gzhan ma byon// nyin bar chos kyi snang bas thub bstan gsal// mtshan mo 'od gsal ngang nas chos kun chub// 'chad rtsod rtsom dang rin chen rig 'dzin sa// lhan cig grub pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar khyod kyis thub pa'i bstan pa la// gzhan dang mi mnyam bgyi ba gang mdzad pa'i// cha tsam mthong la rjes su yid rang bas// khyod bzhin ston pa'i bstan pa 'dzin par shog

/ces bu ston lo tsā ba'i bstod pa bsngags 'os bsngags pa'i phreng ba bzhes bya ba grub pa'o// maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //mi pham g.yag gi mtshan can sangs rgyas dpal la bstod pa rjes 'jug slob ma'i tshogs kyi dang ba'i shing rta 'dren byed bzhugs// ༄// na mo ā r+ya a tsa la/ thub bstan rin chen ma nyams lam gsum pa// gang du bde bar rgyu ba'i lam chen po// 'khyog por byed pa'i gya gyu kun gsal nas// shing rta'i srol chen 'byed mkhas sangs rgyas dpal// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen can rje btsun sa skya pa// 'gro kun dga' mdzad rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i// phul byung phrin las lhag ma'i khur 'degs pa// gangs can mkhas pa'i dbang po sangs rgyas dpal// bcom ldan dpa' bo dman pa'i sa gnyis dang*// bdud bzhi 'gong mdzad mthu stobs dbang phyug gi /dngos grub brnyes pas 'chad dang rtsod pa dang*// phrin las dbang por gyur pa sangs rgyas dpal// ji lta'i don la 'khrul pa sangs pa'i thugs// ji snyed 'chad la blo gros rgyas pa'i gsung*// bstan pa'i dpal gyur 'gro ba 'dren pa'i sku// grags pa'i dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// tshig gtsang don gsal bde 'khyug ljags kyi rtser// gzhung brgya'i tshig don ngang gis shar ba na// 'chad po gzhan kun lce rtsa nyams pa dang*// lce brgya ldan yang ldibs pa lta bur byas// lung dang rigs pa'i 'brug sgras nyer 'khyud pa'i// spobs pa'i glog phreng g.yo ba'i rol rtsed kyis// gzhan gyi smra ba lan brgyar btang gyur nas// mngon par rlom pa'i mdangs kyang nyams par byas// 'chad rtsod snyems pas phyug pa'i pa sangs kyang*// rang gi mdun sar rgyal po bzhin rlom mod// lung dang rigs pa'i zla ba khyod shar tshe// rgyal po'i drung na bran bzhin rgyu bar byed// rtsom pa'i cha shas gang ba'i zla ba yang*// mtshan mo'i mkha' la nyi ma lta bur rlom// 'chad rtsod dbang phyug nyi ma khyod drung du// nye bar lhags na mar ngo bzhin du spyod// khyod kyi mdun sar 'chad dang rtsod rlom pa// nyi ma'i drung du me khyer tshogs rnams dang*// mkha' lding 'dabs su phye ma leb bzhin du// smra ba'i gshog rtse skyod pa ngal min nam// mang thos glang chen rigs pa'i mche ba can// zhi ba'i nags su snyems pa 'chang mod kyang*// 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus su bstan pa yi// gangs ri bsrung ba'i seng chen gzhan yod min// mang thos lang tsho yol nas sgrub pa yi// mchod pas rgyal ba dgyes mdzad mang bzhugs kyang*// nyin bar chos kyi snang bas 'jig rten khams// ma lus nyi ma bzhin du gsal ba dang*// mtshan mo gnyis med zung 'jug 'od dkar gyis// rig 'dzin go 'phang brnyes pa gzhan yod min// rgan po'i gtam rgyud tha snyad cha shas kyis// mkhas pa'i grags thob gyur pa mang mod kyang*// bstan pa'i srog shing mdo rgyud nges don la// bshad sgrub snying por mdzad khyod bstan pa'i rgyan// de ltar khyod kyis ston pa'i bstan pa la// gzhan dang mi mnyam bgyi ba mdzad pa'i tshul// cung zad brjod pas slob ma'i tshogs rnams kyang*// khyod bzhin ston pa'i bstan pa gces 'dzin shog

/lcags pho stag la bltams pa nas bzung ste// shing pho rta la zhi bar gshegs kyi bar// re lnga'i lor bzhugs rang rgyud grol ba dang*// gzhan rgyud smin pa'i phrin las rgya cher mdzad// brtson 'grus dpal las nges par rab tu byung*// bu ston kha ches lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad// lung mang po yis dge mtshan mang gzigs nas// shes phyin bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol mdzad// nyer lnga'i lo la lhag pa'i lha grub nas// ngag gi dbang por gyur zhing 'dod lha yi// bdud las rnam rgyal rdo rje chos skyong rnams// bran bzhin bkol ba'i phrin las dam pa brnyes// sum cu'i lo la byams pa'i zhal gzigs nas// phyag ring brkyang nas byin brlabs lung bstan dang*// shes phyin dgongs 'grel bcas pa'i bstan pa yi// bdag por gsol ba'i dbugs dbyung dam pa thob// de nas bzung ste mgon khyod bzhugs pa'i khri// gang na 'khod pa'i steng gi nam mkha' la// dga' ldan gnas dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i// lha tshogs mang po yum la mchod phyir lhags// rgyal yum mchod pa'i lha rdzas me tog dang*// chos kyi sdom bzhi gsal ba'i rnga bo che// 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbyings su lhag par gsal// mnyam gzhag mtshan ma'i spros pa las grol zhing*// rjes thob sgyu ma'i rnam rol ngang nyid nas// 'od dpag med pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho yi// dag pa'i dga' ston ma lus khyod kyis gzigs// rmad byung thugs rje'i ma dros mtsho chen las// phrin las chu chen bzhi pa nyer bskrun pas// bu slob ri bo'i khor yug yangs pa'i dbus// shes phyin bstan pa'i rgya mtsho'i lhag par khengs// gzhan sems mkhyen dang sku yi bkod mang dang*// 'byung po 'dul dang lha bu'i bdud btul sogs// dngos grub rnam gnyis brnyes pa'i dpal mnga' ba// mi pham chos rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar khyod kyi legs byas rgya mtsho las// cha shas tsam la dad pa skyed byas nas// rigs par brjod pa'i dge ba gang yod des// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyang*// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bdag po'i dpung tshogs las// rnam par rgyal zhing byams mgon thugs rje yi// bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis ring du 'tsho byed shog

/ces mi pham g.yag gi mtshan can sangs rgyas dpal la bstod pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ rjes 'jug slob ma'i tshogs kyi dang ba'i shing rta 'dren byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ dam pa de nyid kyi thugs rje'i dpyang thag la mi phyed pa'i dad pas nye bar 'khyud pa/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ gtsang g.yas ru'i sa'i thig le gser mdog can zhes bya bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// ༈ //bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi bstod pa// ༄// oṃ swi sid+dhaṃ/ bde stong zung 'jug sgyu ma'i rol rtsed mkhan// de sras 'jam pa'i rdo rjer 'khrungs byed thabs// ngo mtshar cho gas de bskrun gzhon nu'i sku// de phyir 'di la gsang bas byin zhes grags// khyod sku sum rtsen dpag bsam 'dod 'jo las// phrag dog lha min lag pas ma brnyabs pa'i// skal bzang lha dbang lang tshor byed pa'i chos// bdud rtsi'i 'bab ngogs bde phyir 'chi med sde// kun la 'jigs med nyi ma khyod drung du// mang thos lung dang rigs pa'i khyu mchog 'ga'// dregs pa'i snyems pa lan brgyar btang byas nas// grags pa'i rnga chen phyogs bcur brdung brtson pa// khyod ni stobs ldan nag po'i phyogs kun las// rnam rgyal mig stong 'phro ba'i lha de bzhin// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i shing rta la chibs nas// thub bstan dga' ba'i tshal du bde bar rgyu// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i le lag gis// sgo mang rim par phye nas chos kyi tshoms// brgyad khri bzhi stong rnam par nges mdzad pa// de phyir chos kyi rgyal po'i mtshan yang bzung*// legs gsungs 'dul ba'i chos kyi khang bzang rtser// ngur smig ba dan g.yo ba'i rgyal mtshan dang*// bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i rnga sgra can// bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dzin mdzad khyod kyi mtshan// gzhon nu nyid nas snying rje'i ngang tshul can// rab tu byon nas zhi zhing dul la mkhas// kun la mtho 'tsham mi mnga' thugs gzu ba// de skad ngang tshul zhi ba'i mtshan yang bzung*// lhums su zhugs dang sku bltams rol rtsed nas// ji srid bstan pa'i bdag por gyur gyi bar// sangs rgyas sras dang dam can srung ma yis// nges par bskyangs phyir mtshan yang de ltar grags// gang khyod 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid kyi phyir// rig byed dran po'i zhal gyi pad+ma las// nges 'khrungs dbyangs can dpal mo khyod la brtse// de phyir dbyangs can dga' ba'i gtam chen po// chos dang srid dang rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag

/gang la ma sbyangs de la yod min pa// yongs rdzogs gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta// dbyangs can dgyes pa'i nyi ma gcig pu yis// 'dzam gling ngo mtshar gyur pa'i rgyan drug dang*// shong gnyis spang dang byang rtse grags pa'i zhabs// mang pos mi bskrun paṇa chen de dag gi /yongs rdzogs mdzad pa skad cig nyid la gsal// gsung gcig nyid kyis mang po'i rna bar yang*// du mar go nas cig char 'bri nus pa// srid gsum sgyu ma'i rnam rol mkhan de yi// rnam 'phrul min nam gzhan du 'di ko ci// 'khrungs ma thag nas mtha' yas 'gro ba 'di// las dang nyon mongs pas bskrun rnam smin gyi// 'khrul 'khor rnam bzhis mnar ba ma bzod nas// spyan gyi chab kyang bkod ma'i rgyun bzhin 'bebs// spyan ras gzigs la snying rje'i rgyang 'bod btang*// 'jig rten dbang pos 'dzum zhal dngos su bstan// 'gro la snying rje'i dbang phyag nyid gyur zhes// mang pos bsngags khyod kun gyis bkur ba'i gnas// bdun phrag lo nas tshad ldan gzhung la sbyangs// nges par byang chub thugs la zhen zhing gshin// gang gang don 'di ston pa'i tshig ci zhes// mkhas mang gis dris thogs pa med gsung mdzad// bcu drug lo nas dpal ldan dpa' bo dang*// zla bar grags pa'i snyems pa sad gyur nas// zab mo'i don la bsnyengs bral spobs pa dang*// gzhan gyis mi 'gran snyan ngag dbang por gyur// nyer gcig lo nas shing rta'i srol mang phye// dbyangs can dpal mo'i dngos grub brnyes pa las// mkhas mang tshogs pa'i dbus su ngo mtshar gtam// rigs shing grol bar smra mkhas bstan pa'i rgyan// rdo rje sems dpa' gnang ba rab thob nas// de nyid 'dus pa'i bstan bcos rtsom bzhed tshe// 'jigs med 'byung gnas zhes bya'i paṇ+ḍi tas// stobs ldan glang chen bdun gyis bkur ba'i chos// so sor phye nas rigs par khyod la gtad// mtha' yas bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol nas// 'chad mkhas rtsod pa'i dbang por kun la grags// skal bzang slob ma'i blo gros spel ba dang*// pha rol rtsod pa'i khyu mchog zil gyis mnan// rtsom la 'gran bral 'di dang gang mtshungs pa// gangs can yul du byon pa smos ci dgos// 'phags pa'i yul du'ang sngon chad byon pa med// dbyangs can dgyes pa'i nyin byed bsngags par 'os// nyin bar 'chad rtsod rtsom pas dus 'da' zhing*// mtshan mo bde stong chen po'i rnam rol gyis// dngos grub rnam gnyis grub pa'i dbang po des// skal bzang 'gro ba ma lus rjes 'dzin shog
